title: DataBall must return columnar and streaming reads
lead: `Filter` returns a fully loaded `List<Dictionary>` today (`DataBall.Filter.cs:45`), and a handler's rows are all buffered before `AddRows` (`DataBall.Open.cs:70`). Add `ReadColumns(filter, cols)` (typed arrays for plots) and `ReadRowsAsync` (streaming rows), and batch handler writes.
